question: What outcome regarding age and death follows from daily non-eating practice?
premises: Daily non-eating is the means described
Age and death are the object of the outcome
inference: Through daily non-eating, one will go beyond death by aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean approaching death or transcending it; context suggests overcoming
plain_english: By not eating for a day, one will overcome death by aging.
